zhs.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.description:
你走进一条摆满石像的长廊。每张石脸都带着同样的惊讶。

廊道尽头，一名蛇发女子正在解开一条打结的蛇。
“看地面。很好。”
她将一只空碟推到你面前。
“现在，我们可以谈谈价钱。”
zhs.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.options.RETU: 失去[gold]石化蟾蜍[/gold]。获得[gold]美杜莎之发[/gold]。
zhs.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.options.OFFE: 失去[red]{Gold}[/red][gold]金币[/gold]。使一张牌获得[purple]稳定[/purple]。
zhs.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.RETURN_TO_OWNER.desc:
你将[gold]石化蟾蜍[/gold]放进碟子。她肩上的蛇齐刷刷地转过头。

“总算找到了。”
她摘下一绺蛇发，塞进你的掌心。
“拿好。别让它们自己打结。”
zhs.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.OFFER_GOLD.descripti:
你将金币放进碟子，把选中的牌递过去。她用指尖压住牌角。

纸面变得像石头一样僵硬。
“现在它不会乱跑了。”
你将牌收好。碟子已经空了。
zhs.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.GREET.description:
你朝她点了点头，没有靠近那只碟子。

她等了片刻，叹了口气，将一个小瓶子递给你。瓶身、瓶塞，甚至里面的气泡都是石头。
“送你的。别往牙上磕。”
zhs.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
你脚下的石板突然一沉。

[jitter]咔嚓！[/jitter]
一片锯刃从前方的转角滚出，沿着石径朝你冲来。锯齿刮过地面，火星四溅。

两边都是石墙。你摸向手中的牌……
zhs.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.options.I: 移除一张攻击牌或技能牌。获得[blue]2[/blue]张附有[purple]{Enchantment}[/purple]的复制品。
zhs.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.IMPROVISE.selecti: 选择一张攻击牌或技能牌进行分裂。
zhs.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.ABORTED.descripti:
你还没抽出那张牌，锯刃就擦着你的衣角滚了过去。

你贴着石墙站了一会儿，等它的声音彻底消失。
zhs.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.IMPROVISE.descrip:
你将一张牌迎向锯齿。

[jitter]嘶啦！[/jitter]
两片纸飘落到你脚边。你捡起它们，发现每片都变成了一张完整的牌。它们摸起来轻了许多。

锯刃继续向前滚去。你检查了一下自己的手指。都在。
zhs.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.THROW.description:
你将一张牌掷进锯齿。纸片卷进轮毂，锯刃跳了两下，停在你脚边。

你小心地跨过去。它又响了一声，你立刻加快了脚步。

eng.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.description:
You enter a gallery lined with statues. Every stone face wears the same surprised expression.

At the far end, a snake-haired woman is untangling one of her snakes.
“Eyes on the floor. Good.”
She slides an empty dish toward you.
“Now we can talk prices.”
eng.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.RETURN_TO_OWNER.desc:
You set the [gold]Petrified Toad[/gold] in the dish. Every snake on her shoulders turns toward it.

“There you are.”
She plucks a lock of hair and drops it into your palm.
“Keep it. And mind the knots.”
eng.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.OFFER_GOLD.descripti:
You put the coins in the dish and hand her your chosen card. She presses a finger to its corner.

The paper stiffens like stone.
“That should keep it from wandering off.”
You pocket the card. The dish is already empty.
eng.THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.GREET.description:
You give her a nod and leave the dish alone.

After a moment, she sighs and hands you a little bottle. The bottle, its stopper, even its bubbles are made of stone.
“A gift. Keep it away from your teeth.”
eng.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
The flagstone beneath your foot sinks.

[jitter]CLACK![/jitter]
A sawblade rolls around the bend ahead and comes straight for you. Its teeth scrape the stones, scattering sparks.

Walls on both sides. You reach for your cards...
eng.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.options.I: Remove an Attack or Skill card. Add [blue]2[/blue] copies [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
eng.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.IMPROVISE.selecti: Choose an Attack or Skill card to split.
eng.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.ABORTED.descripti:
Before you can draw the card, the blade grazes your clothes and rolls past.

You stay against the wall until you can't hear it anymore.
eng.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.IMPROVISE.descrip:
You hold a card up to the teeth.

[jitter]RRRIP![/jitter]
Two scraps drift to your feet. When you pick them up, each has become a complete card. They feel much lighter.

The blade rolls on. You count your fingers. All there.
eng.CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.THROW.description:
You throw a card into the teeth. Paper winds around the axle. The blade hops twice and stops at your feet.

You step carefully over it. It clatters again. You hurry on.

zhs.THINGS_MEDUSA_HAIR.description: 战斗开始时，将[gold]岩石铠甲[/gold][green]+[/green]和[gold]巨石[/gold][green]+[/green]加入你的手牌。它们的费用变为[blue]0[/blue]。[gold]巨石[/gold][green]+[/green]获得[gold]消耗[/gold]。
zhs.THINGS_MEDUSA_HAIR.flavor: 离开她的脑袋后，它们终于停止争吵。

eng.THINGS_MEDUSA_HAIR.description: At the start of combat, add [gold]Stone Armor[/gold][green]+[/green] and [gold]Giant Rock[/gold][green]+[/green] to your hand. They cost [blue]0[/blue]. [gold]Giant Rock[/gold][green]+[/green] gains [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
eng.THINGS_MEDUSA_HAIR.flavor: Off her head, the snakes finally stop arguing.
